_comment: QR payload -> fork-road action. The decoded QR text is looked up as a key in 'actions'. Alternatively the QR may directly encode a JSON object with the same fields. type: left|right|straight|station|stop. turn_speed rad/s, turn_time s, cross_speed m/s, cross_time s, hold_time s (<=0 = latch / stay stopped until line_track 'switch' is toggled).
